Definition: Whether primary laws, acts, or legal instruments exist that establish authority for cross-government data sharing and govern the data exchange system
Comments: No laws for cross-government data sharing identified. No data protection law, no cybercrime law. UNDP Digital Development Compass scores Emerging Technologies and Data and Privacy both at Stage 1 (No recognition). The only privacy reference is Article 18 of the 1997 Constitution.

Definition: Whether a detailed implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, and timelines exists for data exchange development
Comments: No implementation roadmap for government data exchange or interoperability documented. UNDP Implementation Capacity and Systems scored at Stage 1 (Analogue: No skills, outsourcing, no strategy, no budget).

Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: UNDP Digital Development Compass explicitly scores Eritrea's Data Exchange as Stage 1: Basic - 'Offline: No data exchange, paper-based, no systems.' UN e-Government Online Service Index = 0. E-Government rank 190/193. No government digital services documented.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: Limited accessibility. Internet penetration at 20% (2025), gender gap in mobile internet = 100% (meaning women have no access), access to SIM cards requires government approval. UNDP scores Civic Engagement at Stage 1 (Restricted: Tech not for citizen-government interaction).

Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: No data protection law found. UNDP scores Data and Privacy at Stage 1 (No recognition: No data protection, access barriers). Article 18 of 1997 Constitution affirms individual right to privacy but no implementing legislation. No cybersecurity strategy; lacks a cybercrime law.

Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: With no operational data exchange system, sub-national participation is effectively non-existent. Internet penetration at 20% nationally (2025). Electricity access concentrated in major cities; rural areas lack connectivity.

Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: Extreme urban-rural digital divide. Electricity is mainly concentrated in major cities; remote areas lack electricity. Internet infrastructure relies on satellite and limited terrestrial connections. Physical Infrastructure scored Stage 1 (Outdated: Limited coverage, unreliable infrastructure).
